metadata.name: CivicAI photo issue classifier

dataset_licenses.road_issues_detection_dataset: CC0-1.0 as declared by its Hugging Face card; upstream source terms may also apply
dataset_licenses.taco: CC BY 4.0 as stated by the CivicAI dataset kit; verify image-level terms before redistribution

dataset_citations: Disansa et al. (2025), Road Issues Detection Dataset, DOI: 10.57967/hf/6188
Proença and Simões (2020), TACO: Trash Annotations in Context
limitations: Photo-only classifier; it does not read descriptions or set priority/status.
Infrastructure examples cover damaged roads and broken signs; Sanitation examples cover littering and waste.
A low-confidence output is shown as uncertain; staff must make the final decision.
Dataset images come from multiple sources and locations; local barangay accuracy may differ.
